content.title: Celtics-Hawks recap: Atlanta gets revenge against Tatum-less C's
content.text: Boston CelticsLive Blog EndedMar 30, 2026 Boston was outscored 36-22 in the third quarter of its 112-102 loss. By Justin Leger • Published March 30, 2026 • Updated on March 31, 2026 at 8:41 am NBC Universal, Inc. Our Postgame Live crew breaks down the Celtics’ 112-102 loss to the Atlanta Hawks What to KnowChris Forsberg and Kayla Burton shared more postgame reaction on the Celtics Talk Podcast.Jaylen Brown tallied 29 points (9-29 FG) with 10 rebounds and nine assists in his return.Luka Garza notched 20 points and nine rebounds in a starting role.Boston was outscored 36-22 in the third quarter.Celtics' three-game win streak snapped. Turnovers and a rough third quarter cost the Boston Celtics in their 112-102 loss to the Atlanta Hawks on Monday night. The C's turned it over 15 times in total and were outscored 36-22 in the third quarter. They were without Jayson Tatum (right Achilles repair reconditioning) and Neemias Queta (right thumb sprain) on the second night of their back-to-back. Jaylen Brown returned from a two-game absence and dropped a team-high 29 points, though he shot just 9-of-29 from the floor and had six turnovers. Luka Garza was a bright spot with 20 points in Queta's spot. Atlanta evened the season series at 2-2 with its win, which avenged its Friday loss to Boston. The C's will look to bounce back Wednesday in Miami. Follow our live blog below for score updates, highlights, news, and reaction throughout the matchup: The Boston Celtics fell to the Atlanta Hawks 112-102 on Monday night, snapping their three-game win streak. Boston was without Jayson Tatum (right Achilles repair reconditioning) and Neemias Queta (right thumb sprain) on the second night of a back-to-back. Jaylen Brown returned to the lineup after a two-game absence, though he struggled before finding his shot near the end of the fourth quarter. He shot just 9-of-29 from the floor with six turnovers, but he still finished with an impressive stat line of 29 points, 10 rebounds, and nine assists. Luka Garza got the start in Queta's place and was a bright spot with 20 points and nine rebounds. Payton Pritchard added 16 points with four 3-pointers off the bench. Turnovers led to Boston's demise as it coughed up the ball 15 times in the defeat. The third quarter was the difference as the Hawks outscored the C's 36-22 in the frame. Jaylen Brown missed two games with Achilles tendinitis and appeared to aggravate the injury at the end of the third quarter of Monday's loss, though he stayed in the game and dropped 14 points in the fourth. After the defeat, Brown said he isn't worried about the injury: “Nah, everybody’s dealing with something," he said. "Just some soreness. Definitely want to make sure you stay healthy as much as possible and you don’t want to risk anything, but it’ll be fine going forward.” Jaylen Brown discusses how he’s feeling after missing two games due to Achilles tendinitis Luka Garza has come up big as a scorer on several occasions during his first season with the Celtics. The big man dropped 20 points in Monday's loss and spoke after the game about stepping up as a scorer: Our Postgame Live crew reacts to the Jayson Tatum-less Celtics' 112-102 loss to the Hawks, which featured 15 Boston turnovers: Our Postgame Live crew breaks down the Celtics' 112-102 loss to the Atlanta Hawks Joe Mazzulla shared his take on the Celtics' 112-102 loss to the Hawks, noting that his team was "just not sharp in our execution." Score: 101-85 Hawks, 5:45 left in fourth quarter The Celtics went on a 5-0 run before the Hawks timeout, but they trail by 16 with just under six minutes remaining. Boston is shooting just 38 percent from the floor with 14 turnovers. Luka Garza has a team-high 18 points. Score: 90-76 Hawks The Celtics will have to mount a fourth-quarter comeback as they trail by 14 after a rough third. Boston was outscored 36-22 in the frame. It has been an especially off night for Jaylen Brown (15 points), who's shooting 4-of-18 from the floor with five turnovers in his return from a two-game absence. He went down with an apparent leg injury toward the end of the third quarter, but stayed in the game. Luka Garza and Payton Pritchard have been bright spots with 16 points apiece, but the C's are shooting just 40 percent from the floor. The Hawks have shot 52 percent from the field. Dyson Daniels leads Atlanta with 18 points. Score: 79-68 Hawks, 4:27 left in third quarter The Hawks have widened their lead to 11 points by outscoring the Celtics so far in the third, 25-14. Turnovers continue to be an issue for the C's. They've turned it over 12 times, with Jaylen Brown accounting for four of them. Brown has 12 points on 4-of-16 shooting so far in his return from a two-game absence. Luka Garza and Payton Pritchard lead Boston with 16 apiece. Score: 70-65 Hawks, 7:01 left in third quarter The Celtics' supporting cast has been excellent thus far, especially Luka Garza (16 points, 6-6 FG) and Payton Pritchard (13 points, 3-4 3-PT). For Boston to retake the lead and keep its win streak alive, Jaylen Brown and Derrick White will have to find their groove. Brown has 12 points and seven assists, but is shooting just 4-of-14 from the floor with four turnovers. White (seven points) is 3-for-10 from the floor. Sam Hauser made his 700th career 3-pointer tonight at Atlanta, becoming the 10th Celtic to reach that mark, according to Celtics Stats on X. Hauser notched five points and three rebounds off the bench in the first half. Score: 54-54 We're knotted up at 54 after an entertaining first half in Atlanta. With Jayson Tatum and Neemias Queta sidelined, the Celtics were led by Luka Garza (13 points) and Payton Pritchard (13 points) over the first 24 minutes. Garza got off to a hot start with eight points in his first six minutes, and Pritchard finished the half with three 3-pointers. Jaylen Brown has six points (2-9 FG), five rebounds, and six assists after missing the last two games due to Achilles tendinitis. Reserve big men Amari Williams (two points, six rebounds) and Charles Bassey (two points, two blocks) made an impact during their brief stints. Score: 48-45 Hawks, 3:51 left in second quarter Celtics big man Charles Bassey, who recently signed another 10-day contract with the team, is making his presence felt. He has two blocks -- including a big one that led to a Derrick White 3-pointer on the other end -- and a bucket in his four minutes off the bench. Payton Pritchard added his third 3 of the game to give himself a team-high 13 points, but Boston trails by three. Jalen Johnson and Dyson Daniels lead the Hawks with nine points apiece. Score: 38-37 Hawks, 6:56 left in second quarter The Hawks started the second quarter on a 7-0 run to pull ahead of the C's. Boston has since bounced back with a 7-2 run to cut the deficit back to one. Luka Garza (11 points) and Payton Pritchard (10 points) have carried Boston offensively so far. Score: 30-29 Celtics The Celtics lead by one after one despite turning it over seven times in the frame. Jaylen Brown accounted for three turnovers, though he scored six points (2-7 FG) with three rebounds and three assists. Luka Garza got the start for the injured Neemias Queta and scored eight quick points. Payton Pritchard added eight of his own with a pair of 3-pointers. Rookie big man Amari Williams has six rebounds in just six minutes for Boston. Jalen Johnson leads the Hawks with seven points. Score: 22-19 Celtics, 2:59 left in first quarter Payton Pritchard dropped 36 points the last time these two teams faced off on Friday. The Celtics sharpshooter has five points in three minutes off the bench so far. Amari Williams is getting some early minutes for Boston. He already has a bucket and four rebounds in three minutes. Score: 12-12, 6:24 left in first quarter Celtics big man Luka Garza got the start with Neemias Queta sidelined, and he is scorching out of the gate. He already has a game-high eight points (3-3 FG) midway through the frame. Derrick White and Jordan Walsh both added a bucket apiece. Jaylen Brown is 0-for-2 from the floor with two turnovers so far in his return. The C's are 5-of-9 from the floor while the Hawks are 6-of-11. Celtics: Derrick White, Jaylen Brown, Jordan Walsh, Baylor Scheierman, Luka Garza Hawks: Dyson Daniels, Nickeil Alexander-Walker, Corey Kispert, Jalen Johnson, Onyeka Okongwu Celtics coach Joe Mazzulla is a frontrunner for 2025-26 NBA Coach of the Year, but it doesn't sound like he'll be celebrating if he wins the award. “I think it’s a stupid award," he said before Monday's game. "They shouldn’t have it.” Celtics Derrick White (right knee contusion) - AVAILABLE Jayson Tatum (Achilles repair) - OUT Neemias Queta (right thumb sprain) - OUT Ron Harper Jr. (right ankle sprain) - OUT Nikola Vucevic (right ring finger fracture) - OUT Hawks None
